orig.il: And it came to pass, when David

orig.gloss: and/ they had driven them away

orig.il: until they had no more power
I pray thee, bring me hither
where those that were left behind
that they could not go over

orig.gloss: and/ they gave to drink/ him

orig.il: to him: for he had eaten
to him, Canst thou bring me down

orig.gloss: and/ I will take down/ you
orig.il: and I will bring thee down
And when he had brought him down

orig.gloss: and/ they had left behind/ them
orig.il: whom they had made also to abide
not with us, we will not give
